name: day-at-office
description: The view of Mumbai from a high office window, traced from a photograph, under the live sky of a city you choose: real sunrise and sunset, current weather and season, and a gauge on the right showing context and tokens used.

city.title: City
city.description: The city whose time, sunrise and sunset, season and live weather the sky follows, such as "London" or "Paris, France". Weather comes from Open-Meteo. The skyline stays the Mumbai view.
